_comment: Expiry-dated npm-audit allowlist — the ONLY escape hatch for the `npm audit (console)` L4 security gate (ISI-5426).
Mirrors .trivyignore (ISI-2245, §6.2): reviewed like code, never a silent perpetual mute.
Keys are GHSA advisory ids. Each entry MUST carry `expires` (YYYY-MM-DD) and a one-line `justification`.
The security.yml npm-audit step FAILS the build when: (a) a high/critical advisory is NOT allowlisted here,
or (b) an allowlisted entry is past its `expires` date. An allowlisted advisory that is no longer present
(upstream fixed / chain dropped) emits a ::warning:: so the stale entry gets removed — same discipline as trivy.
An unfixable finding still needs an entry; a fix landing upstream turns a muted HIGH into a gating one, so track it here.

GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm.justification: braces <=3.0.3 stack-exhaustion DoS; NO upstream fix (latest published braces is 3.0.3 and the advisory covers <=3.0.3; micromatch@4.0.8 still pins braces ^3.0.3). Dev-only: reaches solely via eslint-config-next -> @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob -> micromatch -> braces, never in the shipped console runtime. Remove when braces publishes a fixed release or eslint-config-next's chain drops it (npm's only 'fix' is a semver-major eslint-config-next@14 downgrade that breaks Next-15 parity).
